comment: Boring and the exams require a ridiculous amount of material to study.

Professor Conover is a solid teacher. His lectures can get somewhat occasionally but he tries to through in his dad jokes to lighten the mood. He is a fair grader and has clear criteria. The multiple choice on tests is difficult but he provides lots of study material in the course pack. Overall, rather challenging but definitely worth it.

Im doing very well in class, but its hard stuff. Avg for the midterm was a 70 something. Thank God it was open notes for this semester. Would've failed if it wasnt. Class is just him talking and asking some basic questions, so its super boring. I fall asleep every class and teach myself afterwards.
Very funny and a good teacher. Tests are very difficult and require a lot of preparation.
Great teacher who really cares. Tries to be funny in a good way. Nothing unexpected on his tests. Short quizzes on short readings that boost your grade. I liked him a lot!
Great professor and nice personality. Always willing to help during his office hour. Easy test and grading criteria.

The class seems a little slow at times.  Copy the notes, study the notes, and study the old practices.  You'll learn quite a bit about how the currency markets function as well as hedging risk.  Conover obviously cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Best finance class I ever had! It's not possible to get an easy A, but you will learn a lot about currencies markets. I have gained a lot of knowledge in this course and I would advise everybody who's interested in Finance to take his class.

Nice Guy but a Horrible professor. Does no real teaching in class. If you are coming straight out of FIN 360, DO NOT TAKE HIM. He DOES NOT TEACH. However, if you have a lot of Finance background, it will be an easy class.

Took Fin 361 in Spring 2010 with him and he is the worst professor I've had at BSchool.  Doesn't have great teaching techniques and expects students to know things that we were never taught. Stay away.
great guy                          hard class and hard worker
Very nice guy with fair to easy tests. His teaching style sometimes gets boring after he does one example after another on the board.
